summary: A picture panned and zoomed inside a round or square frame, for an avatar or a cover; it reports the crop as a PNG.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the cropped picture as a PNG, after each pan or zoom settles.

props.name: crop
props.description: A round crop for avatars, or a square one.

props.name: maxZoom
props.description: How far the slider zooms in.

props.name: size
props.description: The cropped picture's width and height in pixels.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius of the frame. Inherits the nearest `Shape`.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. `merge` folds them in last, so one here replaces the component's own class for the same utility.

props.name: focus
props.description: The focus outline. `true` draws it, `false` removes it, and a string of Yumma CSS utilities restyles it on every focusable part of the component, which is more than `className` reaches. Removing it outright and putting nothing back fails WCAG 2.4.7.
